paragraphs: NIRA Dynamics sells Tire Pressure Indicator, software that determines tire inflation pressure from wheel speed signals instead of in-wheel sensors. Loose Wheel Indicator uses the same wheel speed signals to detect a wheel that is coming loose and to identify which wheel it is. Both products run on sensors the vehicle already has and are integrated into an existing control unit, so no additional hardware is required.

Vehicle Assistance, Driver Support and Road Maintenance are the three areas the product collection is presented under. Winter Road Insights is offered to road owners and operators as connected vehicle data for winter maintenance. Road Health is described as an automated system for road monitoring that uses connected vehicle data to lower operational costs.

Car manufacturers are named as one group the products are meant to serve, alongside road maintenance. The company describes itself as a supplier with certifications such as TISAX, ISO 9001, Automotive SPICE and AUTOSAR.

quote.text: Enhancing road safety through real-time insights, WRI empowers road owners and operators with connected vehicle data for efficient, proactive winter maintenance.
